CommunityApplications.Profile:
Sylo is a multi-function Discord bot with a web dashboard, built for self-hosting on Unraid.
It has a per-guild module system — moderation with warning thresholds, server logging, tickets/modmail answered from the dashboard, reaction roles & autoroles, welcome/leave messages, sticky messages, auto-moderation (invite/link/flood/mention/caps/word filters), a counting mini-game, and a message/embed creator — plus per-server slash-command management and Battlefield-series player stats via the public gametools.network API. State lives in a single SQLite file on a mounted volume and survives updates.
**Support:** open an issue at https://github.com/Ferdinand99/Sylo/issues
